body:
Founder real-time, twice: 'it just says running... no idea whats going on.' Real gap: model.learn() ran with verbose=0, producing zero output for the entire duration of a training chunk (potentially very long on a slow/starved machine) -- made 'alive but crawling' indistinguishable from 'frozen' with nothing to check. New _HeartbeatCallback prints elapsed time + measured steps/sec every 200 env steps. Live-verified against a real running server: heartbeat line appeared exactly as expected mid-chunk. 125/125 tests pass, purely additive (no reward/training logic change). BRAWLPIT commit 8d4e066.

⚓ ☃
title: S437: real heartbeat progress output during training
